scope: Belize medical discovery — University of Belize School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Belize states that its School of Medicine admitted its first cohort in August 2024 and that it is preparing/submitting for provisional CAAM-HP accreditation.
UB's official MBBS admissions material identifies a Medical School Admissions Committee and publishes admission prerequisites and a course sequence.

holdReasons: The school reports that it is preparing/submitting for provisional accreditation; this material status must prevent any claim of completed programme accreditation.
No current complete fee schedule, active intake calendar, clinical-placement agreements, accommodation, scholarship/loan support or graduate-registration pathway was located.
A programme with a 2024 first cohort needs current independent quality/approval evidence before it can meet the gold-standard publication bar.
nextAction: Verify current CAAM-HP and Belize regulator status, active fee/admissions information, clinical partners and student support before considering a payload.
